question: In March 2022, who broke the legendary Kapil Dev's, 40-year-old record of ‘the fastest Test Fifty’ by an Indian?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh Pant.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rishabh Pant **on **13 Mar'22 broke Kapil Dev's 40-year-old **record of the **fastest Test fifty by an Indian** on the 2nd day of the Day/Night match against **Sri Lanka.**
 
• He also set a world record for notching up the **fastest fifty by a wicketkeeper-batter in Tests**.
 
• He cruised to his fifty in **28 balls in the 42nd over of the second innings**, Kapil Dev's being a 30-ball half-century against Pakistan in 198.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Rishabh Pant**

 
• ​Rishabh Rajendra Pant, an Indian international cricketer who was born on October 4, 1997, is a wicket-keeper batter for the Indian cricket team.
 
• He is best known for his ability to consistently score runs in Test cricket despite playing in all formats for India.
 
• He served as vice-captain of the India U-19 team, which finished second at the Under-19 Cricket World Cup in 2016.
 
• Pant won the Men's Player of the Month award at the first ICC Player of the Month Awards in February 2021.
 
• After the designated captain, KL Rahul was ruled out of the series due to an injury, Pant was selected as India's captain for the T20I series against South Africa in June 2022

**MS Dhoni**

 
• ​Mahendra Singh Dhoni is an Indian former** international cricketer** who was born on **July 7, 1981.**
 
• He was **captain **of the Indian national cricket team from **2007 to 2017** in limited-overs formats and from **2008 to 2014 in Test cricket. **
 
• He is the** CSK IPL captain** at the moment.

**Shreyas Iyer**

 
• **​**Shreyas Santosh Iyer is an Indian international cricketer who was **born on December 6, 1994.**
 
• He bats** right-handed **for the Indian cricket team. He has represented the Indian team in all formats.
 
• Iyer became the f**irst Indian player** to score a** century** in his first test match and a half-century in his second innings against **New Zealand in November 2021.**

**​R Ashwin**

 
• ​Ravichandran Ashwin is an Indian international cricketer who was** born on September 17, 1986.**
 
• He bats right-handed and **bowls right-arm off-break** for the Indian cricket team.
 
• He also plays for **Rajasthan Royals** in the Indian Premier League and **Tamil Nadu** in domestic cricket.
 
• He also holds **some records** as the joint **fastest bowler** in the world.
